purpose: Fail-closed Chat execution reliability contract for dispatch confirmation, unreadable-conversation recovery, and duplicate-prevention for visual production.

pass_requires_all: post-send browser URL is the current project's conversation URL containing /c/
post-send active processing or response-start state is positively observed
insufficient_evidence: Git task or task record exists
prompt is filled in the editor
Enter/send was attempted without post-send evidence
chat_dispatch_confirmation.reporting_rule: Do not report actual start unless every pass requirement is positively observed.

unreadable_conversation_recovery.trigger_requires: The execution Chat previously passed CHAT_DISPATCH_CONFIRMATION and later becomes unreadable, unavailable, or shows an equivalent load failure.
immediate_actions: STOP interaction with the unreadable execution Chat
required_readback_before_any_rerun: current task authority and repository/head authority

decisions.when: durable_output_absent AND old_task_blocked AND frozen_scope_unchanged AND authority_head_unchanged

unreadable_conversation_recovery.fresh_recovery_invariant: Fresh recovery reuses the frozen scope and existing execution budget. It does not create an additional creative attempt.

required_task_declarations: expected durable output identity/path/manifest when applicable
hard_rules: Unreadable Chat UI alone never authorizes another image generation.
Cannot see old Chat is not evidence that the old generation did not happen.
Existing durable output must be recovered and validated before any duplicate generation is considered.
Fresh recovery must not silently increase generation_count, reroll count, best-of-N attempts, or hidden variants.
Publish/write policy remains unchanged across fresh recovery unless separately re-authorized by current authority.

route_semantics_lock.note: This contract changes execution reliability only. It does not alter the six content/aesthetic/business route meanings, visual taste thresholds, typography, color, layout, user preference, or business rollout logic.
